title: Rotto After Dark
style: 128 bpm, hard electro swing house, four-on-the-floor kick, aggressive sub bass drop, brass stabs, swing piano riff, heavy snare build risers, DJ festival drop structure, chant hook vocals, male hype with female lead, club mix, wide stereo energy, peak time
lyrics:
[Intro - filtered swing piano + kick pulse]

[Chant Hook]
Hey — Pelican run the night
Hey — Rotto moon ignite

[Verse 1 - Male Hype, swing rap]
Carnac splash, Rotto sand at the bow
Pete cuts the engine, Brandon checks the prow
Indian Ocean pulse, the moon comes out the dark
The Pelican drops anchor, the family lights the spark
BYO cold, eskies packed up tight
BBQ flame on the back deck right

[Build - snare roll]
From Swan River glide to the open sea
Wave that glass in your hand, the family's free

[Drop 1 - HEAVY]
Rotto after dark — strike the spark
West coast rhythm — tear apart
Livewire bassline — hit the mark
Indian Ocean pulse — leave a mark

[Verse 2 - Fem Lead, swing energy]
Bucks night roar, crew on fire
Last run free before the wire
Shoes off, speakers up
Good mates laughing in the cup
Pete steady, Brandon ready
The Pelican heavy, the rhythm steady

[Build 2]
Hands in the air, bassline rise
Rottnest moon in the sky

[Drop 2 - Extended]
Pelican — run the coast
Livewire — raise the toast
West side — never ghost
Indian Ocean host
Bounce, bounce — Swan River glide
Bounce, bounce — Perth city side
Bounce, bounce — deck alive
Bounce, bounce — feel the tide

[Breakdown - bass pulse only]
Pete steady
Brandon ready
Pelican heavy
Family ready

[Final Drop - MAX]
After dark we own the sea
Private cruise, just family
West coast sound, swing and grind
Leave the shoreline far behind

[Outro - brass hit + fade]
Pete — Brandon — Pelican
Rotto after dark — family run
